newsitem.title: LEBANON: BLC shares continue rise on Beirut market.
newsitem.headline: BLC shares continue rise on Beirut market.

text.p: Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce (BLC) rose on Friday on the Beirut Stock Exchange for the third successive day since its shares began trading this week.

Shares in BLC, the first bank listed since the exchange reopened last January, closed at $11.75 on turnover of 10,000 shares compared with $11.50 on Thursday on trade of 5,000 shares. BLC shares began trading on Monday at $11.25 when 2,000 changed hands.
There was no trade on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Tuesday or Wednesday due to New Year holiday.
Solidere was mixed on Friday as A shares rose to $112 from $111.875 and B shares were steady at $115. Turnover was 2,058 shares from 2,207 on Thursday and value was $232,107.375 from $247,567.5.
There was no trade in the four other listed companies: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index rose 0.02 percent to 81.77 and the BLOM stock index rose 0.06 percent to 948.05.
